details.summary: Added role check in normalizeCodexRolloutMessage: system and developer role messages are now hidden before they enter chat, counts, or titles. This prevents internal context instructions from appearing as user-visible chat bubbles.

Changed bootstrap pattern from /You are (powered by|an?)\s/i to /You are (powered by|an AI)\s/i. The original 'an?' wildcard was too broad and matched genuine role prompts like 'You are an expert reviewer'. The narrowed pattern preserves real user prompts while still catching 'You are an AI' bootstrap injections.

Updated 'falls back to rollout ID in title when no real user text exists' test to use synthetic response_item-only records instead of bootstrap helper. The test now asserts the exact fallback title format (cwd-prefixed rollout ID), verified message counts, and role distribution, proving the title fallback path is exercised without guarded conditions.

Added 'response_item system and developer messages stay hidden while visible chat remains discoverable' test: verifies system/developer messages are excluded while user/assistant messages remain, confirms message counts (2 total), and asserts no system/developer text leaks into transcript.
Added assertion: isBootstrapContextText('You are an expert reviewer; inspect this diff') === false. Ensures the narrowed pattern does not regress on real role prompts.
